Chaos Meter
The global Chaos Meter shortens event timing, unlocks stronger escalation, and
increases eligible cluster pressure as its tier rises.
Deaths System
Military casualties and state-linked civilian deaths from war, disasters,
disease, famine, forced displacement, camps, and unconventional weapons
enter one shared ledger. Civilian entries remove real state population, and each
source can convert its recorded toll into chaos.
Air Cleanliness
Air Cleanliness tracks atmospheric contamination from chemical hazards,
outbreaks, fallout, smoke, ash, and aerosols. Thresholds at 25%, 50%, 75%, and
100% accelerate outbreaks, worsen Air Winter, activate the Air Cleanliness
Treaty, and can enable the Fallout consequence. Its Chaos Meter tab shows
recovery and a permanent source ledger.
Famine Mechanics
Famine tracks Food Security, Food Reserves, and Relief Access in each affected
state. Conditions progress through stable, supply strain, acute shortage,
famine, and catastrophic famine. Relief, route, reserve, import, airlift, and
evacuation actions can reverse pressure, while severe mortality enters the
Deaths System and may create a separate migration request.
Migration Mechanics
Migration tracks Displacement Load, Reception Capacity, and Border Policy as
cohorts move through flight, reception, settlement, resettlement, and return.
Population moves between proven origins and destinations; unsafe routes or
violent pushback can add deaths. Decisions, missions, reports, and the
migration mapmode manage corridors and outcomes.
Camp System Mechanics
The Repression and Camps System covers detention, forced labor, gulags,
experiment programs, discovery, reform, and dismantlement. Active sites
remove real population through the Deaths System and store responsibility
and evidence for later Condemnation. Country routes and its five tabs show
territories, active sites, programs, discovery, and reform without revealing
hidden evidence early.
